summary: Rabbi Hidary examines passages in Masekhet Bechorot about the gestation times and birth characteristics of different animals and plants. He explains a Halakha regarding an egg laid on Yom Tov and when chickens lay eggs. He also shares the story of Rabbi Yoshua ben Hananiah traveling to Athens to debate and defeat sixty Athenian sages with riddles.

questions: Is an egg found on the morning of Yom Tov permitted to be eaten?
How long is the gestation period of a snake according to the Gemara?
Why do humans, fish, and snakes engage in intercourse face to face?
How did Rabbi Yoshua ben Hananiah defeat the sixty sages of Athens?
